attributes.action: Ban private purchase and use of fireworks and limit public displays to 97 dB
attributes.additional_details:
We want to strengthen mandatory fireworks controls:
- ban public sales and private recreational use of conventional fireworks; restrict them to licensed professional public displays; and
- impose a maximum noise limit of 97 dB at 15 metres, including Category F4, with robust safety safeguards and enforcement.
 
We believe this will prevent burns and other harm, protect community wellbeing and domestic and wild animals, and help reduce avoidable costs for animal owners, the NHS, local authorities and other public services.
attributes.background: We want the Government to protect people and animals by banning private purchase and use of fireworks and capping display noise at 97 dB
